items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you:
items.claim: Pharaoh will speak to the addressees requesting a miracle display

items.quote: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh,
items.claim: Moses is commanded to instruct Aaron to take his rod and cast it before Pharaoh
items.action: shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh

items.quote: and it shall become a serpent
items.claim: The rod shall become a serpent
